description: This file implements model fallback logic for an AI system, including error handling, candidate selection, cooldown management, and fallback execution for models and images.

classes.name: FallbackSummaryError
classes.description: Structured error thrown when all model fallback candidates are exhausted, carrying attempt details and cooldown expiry.

methods.name: isFallbackSummaryError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a FallbackSummaryError.

methods.name: buildFallbackSuccess
methods.description: Constructs a successful fallback run result object.

methods.name: runFallbackCandidate
methods.description: Executes a fallback candidate run, normalizing errors and handling aborts.

methods.name: runFallbackAttempt
methods.description: Attempts to run a fallback candidate, returning success or error.

methods.name: sameModelCandidate
methods.description: Checks if two model candidates are the same based on provider and model.

methods.name: throwFallbackFailureSummary
methods.description: Throws a comprehensive error after all fallback attempts fail.

methods.name: resolveFallbackSoonestCooldownExpiry
methods.description: Determines the soonest cooldown expiry among fallback candidates.

methods.name: resolveImageFallbackCandidates
methods.description: Resolves fallback candidates for image models based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveFallbackCandidates
methods.description: Resolves fallback candidates for models based on configuration and overrides.

methods.name: runWithModelFallback
methods.description: Main function to run a task with model fallback logic, handling retries, cooldowns, and errors.

methods.name: runWithImageModelFallback
methods.description: Main function to run a task with image model fallback logic.
